title: How Do I Help My Wife If She's Afraid of Giving Birth?
card: Fear of birth is common, even in moms who did all the preparation. How a partner helps her name the fear, take the real questions to the midwife, and stay steady in the room.
llms: How a partner helps a wife who is afraid of giving birth: ask and listen, name each fear and the truth behind it, take real risks to the midwife together, and stay calm and close in labor, with a former NICU nurse's and a doula's interview words and the Cochrane review on continuous support.
